shortDescription: Manage a datastore on ESXi host

options.name: auto_expand
options.description: Expand a datastore capacity to full if it has free capacity. This parameter can't be extend using another datastore. Can be used to expand a datastore capacity after increasing LUN volume.

options.name: datastore_name
options.description: Name of the datastore to add/remove.

options.name: datastore_type
options.description: Type of the datastore to configure (nfs/nfs41/vmfs/vvol).

options.name: esxi_hostname
options.description: ESXi hostname to manage the datastore. Required when used with a vcenter

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: nfs_path
options.description: Resource path on NFS host. Required if O(datastore_type=nfs) / O(datastore_type=nfs41) and O(state=present), else unused.

options.name: nfs_ro
options.description: ReadOnly or ReadWrite mount. Unused if datastore type is not set to O(datastore_type=nfs) / O(datastore_type=nfs41) and not O(state=present).

options.name: nfs_server
options.description: NFS host serving nfs datastore. Required if O(datastore_type=nfs) / O(datastore_type=nfs41) and O(state=present), else unused. Two or more servers can be defined if O(datastore_type=nfs41)

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: resignature
options.description: Allows forcing resignature of unresolved VMFS datastore that already exists on the specified disk device. Unused if not O(datastore_type=vmfs) and not O(state=present).

options.name: state
options.description: present: Mount datastore on host if datastore is absent else do nothing. absent: Umount datastore if datastore is present else do nothing.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.

options.name: vasa_provider
options.description: hostname or ipaddress of the VASA provider to use for vVols provisioning

options.name: vmfs_device_name
options.description: Name of the device to be used as VMFS datastore. Required for VMFS datastore type and O(state=present), else unused.

options.name: vmfs_version
options.description: VMFS version to use for datastore creation. Unused if not O(datastore_type=vmfs) and not O(state=present).
